name: get_village
description: Summary of the learner's village in the app's game: age, resources, buildings, who is here and met (people.known: all a scene, a request or a line may name) and who waits to be met (people.to_meet), active event, open quests (their module, tries, best try and pass mark, the grammar pages missed, the task a drill helps), help (🤝, earned by helping villagers, spent on a moba), friends, the chest's tools and goods, the village projects (steps done; landmarks_down: finished ones whose landmark is down for the season now, as the maypole after May: not standing in the village or on its square), the calendar (the culture's days on now and the next, a quiet one marked: remembered, not celebrated), spots (the landscape's spots with work over real days, the charcoal pile: its stage today, the day of it, a breakout tonight, the last delivery to the smith), the school's course (the day the class began, the units done and in progress: get_course has the rest), looked_up (the grammar pages Jan looked up on the cheat sheet during exercises in the last two weeks, most first: page, title, n answers given with one of its cards open, the last day; left out when none: work potential, get_course names their units), recent chronicle.
